filter: detectable != False (RAW metadata boolean; NOT str()-coerced)
note_on_image_anomaly_false_object_true: images with image_anomaly=False but object_anomaly=True are KEPT as normal test samples (official rule: the defect is not visible in that view/illum, so the image is normal)
eval_scope: A = official-aligned view120 slice (primary this round); B = full 12-view Invariant (only if budget allows; NOT run by default)

backbones.dinov2s: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 final-layer patch tokens (384-d), input l0_448 448x448
backbones.dinov2b: DINOv2 ViT-B/14 final-layer patch tokens (768-d), input l0_448 448x448

scoring: unified 1-NN: L2-normalise patch features -> cosine distance to nearest bank patch -> image score = max over 1024 patches
scoring_note: identical scoring across all 3 backbones; NO coreset, NO k=9 softmin, NO test-set scoring search. E7 AnomalyDINO scoring (top-1% mean) is historical evidence only, NOT the fair control.
stopping_rules: cache cannot be decoded as RGB image
GPU OOM un-resolvable by smaller batch
exclusions: no training, no Dinomaly/MSFlow, no Car/Cube raw download, no P3 auto-start
